nodes.label: Kotlin Graphify Engine
nodes.description: Generates knowledge_graph.json, MASTER_DIGEST.md, FAMILY_DIGEST.md, and interactive graph.html.

nodes.label: Drive Deep Logging & Telemetry Subsystem
nodes.description: Writes chronological sync_timeline.log and diagnostic_snapshot.json directly to Drive _system/logs/.

nodes.label: K.I.D.S. Android Collector (PRD)
nodes.description: Ambient, privacy-first mobile companion application continuously capturing and organizing school notices.

nodes.label: Memory Boundary Privacy Filter
nodes.description: Drops non-whitelisted apps, personal chats, OTPs, and banking alerts before disk persistence.

nodes.label: WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA Design System
nodes.description: Enforces 48dp touch targets, TalkBack semantics, dynamic scaling, and contrast ratios (11.4:1 AAA Navy).

nodes.label: 4-Step Onboarding Wizard
nodes.description: Guided setup for Cloud Vault, Google Classroom, School ERPs, and WhatsApp Whitelist.

nodes.label: Multi-Tier Testing Pyramid
nodes.description: JUnit 5, MockK, Robolectric, Truth, and Compose Test Rule test suites.

nodes.label: On-Device ML Kit OCR Engine
nodes.description: Offline optical character recognition running locally via play-services-mlkit-text-recognition.

nodes.label: Restricted Drive Scope (drive.file)
nodes.description: Strictly requests https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file avoiding broad drive access.

nodes.label: Zero-Backend Architecture ($0 Cloud Cost)
nodes.description: Student data is never routed through or persisted on third-party servers; syncs directly to parent Google Drive.
